meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 读取本机 screenpipe 记录的屏幕历史,识别反复出现的研究工作流,与已有技能比对;对未覆盖的模式,它会生成「新技能」或「串联已有技能」的草稿,放到本地文件夹供你审阅确认。
howto.when: 当你明确要求分析最近一段时间的工作并提出技能建议,或要求根据近期流程起草技能或组合配方时触发;不会自动运行,也不做实时屏幕问答,且本机 screenpipe 必须可用,否则拒绝运行。

say.text: 分析我昨天的工作,把反复出现但还没覆盖的流程写成技能草稿。
say.note: 会先检查 screenpipe,再生成草稿待你确认。

say.text: 看看我这周做的事情,指出没被已有技能覆盖的部分。
say.note: 它会比对本地技能库并输出报告和草稿。

say.text: 根据我最近 4 小时的文献调研,生成一个新技能草稿。
say.note: 窗口太短时可能因聚类结果不足而不产出。

howto.what_en: Reads the user's local screenpipe history, detects recurring research workflows, compares them against existing skills, and drafts new skills or recipes that chain existing skills for any uncovered pattern. The drafts are kept locally for review.
howto.when_en: Triggered only by an explicit user request to analyze recent work and propose skills, or to draft a skill/composition recipe from recent workflow. It never auto-runs; without a reachable screenpipe it refuses to run.

say_en.text: Analyze yesterday's work and draft a skill for any uncovered recurring workflow.
say_en.note: Checks screenpipe first, then writes proposals.

say_en.text: Look at what I did this week and point out gaps not covered by existing skills.
say_en.note: Matches local skills and outputs proposals.

say_en.text: Draft a new skill from my last 4 hours of literature research.
say_en.note: Very short windows may be dropped during clustering.
